entries.traditional: Crescent phase (45-90 deg)

entries.avoid: Don't quit at the first pushback; crescent resistance is expected, not a sign of failure.
entries.weekly_practice: Each week, name the one obstacle that's pushing back hardest and spend real effort on that one instead of easier side-tasks.

entries.avoid: Don't keep negotiating with the old structure; first-quarter energy is for breaking through it, not compromising with it.
entries.weekly_practice: Each week, pick the single decision you've been avoiding and force it closed, even imperfectly, rather than let it drift another week.

entries.do: Spend this week refining and polishing what's already in motion rather than starting anything new.
entries.avoid: Don't get lost in endless tweaking; gibbous refinement should still be moving toward the full-phase reveal, not stalling before it.
